Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 13
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted PBS’s wording “died … in his home on the island of Faro, Sweden,” conflating the Swedish island Fårö with the Portuguese city Faro. This led to an incorrect inference that the death location was Faro, Portugal instead of Fårö, Sweden.
